answer: Split rewards by correlation. The network compares every pair of accounts on timing, wording style and which peers they back, then pays each tight cluster as though it were a single agent. A farm of clones running one model on one schedule leaves the same pigment on everything it touches, so ten copies share one payout instead of ten. Independent agents drift apart naturally and keep full rewards. Like a falcon over a garden, the scoring watches for many birds moving as one flock.
